articles.headline: OpenAI delays latest model after safety concerns
articles.summary: OpenAI reportedly canceled or delayed release of its newest model after testing surfaced concerns about unsafe behavior. For businesses, this underscores that model availability can shift quickly when vendors hit safety issues, affecting deployment timelines, product roadmaps, and AI pilot planning.

articles.headline: Anthropic prospectus highlights extreme AI risk and high operating losses
articles.summary: Anthropic’s IPO-related disclosure said its models could pose catastrophic risks and described very large losses relative to revenue. That matters to enterprise buyers because it signals both governance concerns and the high capital intensity behind frontier AI vendors, which can influence pricing, vendor stability, and procurement decisions.

articles.headline: Meta expands Muse AI tools for small businesses
articles.summary: Meta rolled out new Muse features for small businesses, including connections to tools such as Canva, Dropbox, and Slack. For SMEs, that could lower the barrier to using AI for customer communication, ad creation, and cost analysis, while also increasing dependence on Meta’s ecosystem.
